name: Senado de la República
notes: 103 seats for 2026-2030: 102 elected on 8 March 2026 and one for the runner-up of the presidential election if in opposition. Who sits is from a news list of the senators elected (Valora Analitik), a secondary source, because senado.gov.co still lists the 2022-2026 senators; parties are the lists they were elected on. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Cámara de Representantes
notes: 183 seats for 2026-2030. Who sits and their party are from the chamber's own page (camara.gov.co/representantes); seats the page does not name are shown as Vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
